use IO.Std.write_line

use VECTOR = (x: int, y: int, z: int)

*(a: VECTOR, b: VECTOR) -> int =>
    a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z

><(a: VECTOR, b: VECTOR) -> VECTOR =>
    (x = a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y,
     y = a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z,
     z = a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x)

let a = (x = 3, y = 4, z = 5)
let b = (x = 4, y = 3, z = 5)
let c = (x = -5, y = -12, z = -13)

write_line("a . b = {a * b}")
write_line("a x b = {a >< b}")
write_line("a . (b x c) = {a * (b >< c)}")
write_line("a x (b x c) = {a >< (b >< c)}")

use IO.Std.write_line

use VECTOR = (x: int, y: int, z: int)

*(a: VECTOR, b: VECTOR) -> int =>
    a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z

><(a: VECTOR, b: VECTOR) -> VECTOR =>
    (x = a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y,
     y = a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z,
     z = a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x)

let a = (x = 3, y = 4, z = 5)
let b = (x = 4, y = 3, z = 5)
let c = (x = -5, y = -12, z = -13)

write_line("a . b = {a * b}")
write_line("a x b = {a >< b}")
write_line("a . (b x c) = {a * (b >< c)}")
write_line("a x (b x c) = {a >< (b >< c)}")
